title: SUI Masih Tertekan, tapi Sinyal Ini Bisa Picu Reversal ke US$0,84
content:
Harga Sui (SUI) masih berada dalam tekanan menjelang September 2026, tetapi sejumlah indikator mulai menunjukkan potensi perubahan arah. Bullish divergence pada pasangan SUI/BTC, arus dana produk ETF, dan meningkatnya aktivitas jaringan menjadi beberapa sinyal yang kini diperhatikan pasar.

title: Deribit moved 90% of client assets to Coinbase, then killed its daily proof-of-reserves check
content:
Deribit will remove its public Proof of Reserves page on Sept. 1, ending a daily check customers could use to verify balance inclusion and compare aggregate liabilities with published wallet holdings. content:
Coinbase US500 futures reached a $100 million milestone, giving the exchange an early test of whether a crypto-native trading mechanism can travel into regulated US equity markets.
